working: C3 -> C3 - x·C1 - C2 zeroes the first two entries of column 3 and leaves -(ax^2+2bx+c) in position (3,3), so the determinant = -(ac-b^2)(ax^2+2bx+c). With a>0 and discriminant 4b^2-4ac<0 we get ac-b^2>0 and ax^2+2bx+c>0, hence the determinant is negative.
notes: Option B, (ac-b^2)(ax^2+2bx+c), is the NEGATIVE of the true determinant — a sign-flipped distractor. If the printed key says B it is wrong; the value is -(ac-b^2)(ax^2+2bx+c), which is -ve, so C is correct.

working: A non-zero solution needs det = 0. Expanding |1 2a a; 1 3b b; 1 4c c| = (3bc-4bc) - 2a(c-b) + a(4c-3b) = -bc + 2ac - ab = 0, i.e. ab + bc = 2ac. Dividing by abc gives 1/a + 1/c = 2/b, so 1/a, 1/b, 1/c are in A.P. and a, b, c are in H.P.
